questions.question: By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be correct? × and +, 6 and 4
questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

× and +, 6 and 4
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Interchanging the given two signs and numbers the following equation will be correct.

Given:- × and +, 6 and 4

Option 1) 3 × 9 – 4 ÷ 2 + 6 = 8

After interchanging the signs and numbers we get the:

⇒ 3 + 9 – 6 ÷ 2 × 4 = 8

⇒ 3 + 9 - 3 × 4 = 8

⇒ 3 + 9 - 12 = 8

⇒ 12 - 12 = 8

⇒ 0 ≠ 8

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 8 × 6 + 4 ÷ 2 – 5 = –5

After interchanging the signs and numbers we get the:

⇒ 8 + 4 × 6 ÷ 2 – 5 = –5

⇒ 8 + 4 × 3 - 5 = -5

⇒ 8 + 12 - 5 = -5

⇒ 20 - 5 = -5

⇒ 15 ≠ -5

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 8 – 3 × 6 + 4 ÷ 1 = 18

After interchanging the signs and numbers we get the:

⇒ 8 – 3 + 4 × 6 ÷ 1 = 18

⇒ 8 - 3 + 4 × 6 = 18

⇒ 8 - 3 + 24 = 18

⇒ 32 - 3 = 18

⇒ 29 ≠ 18

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 7 × 6 – 4 + 9 ÷ 3 = –7

After interchanging the signs and numbers we get the:

⇒ 7 + 4 – 6 × 9 ÷ 3 = –7 

⇒ 7 + 4 - 6 × 3 = -7

⇒ 7 + 4 - 18 = -7

⇒ 11 - 18 = -7

⇒ -7 = -7

⇒ LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Which of the following interchange of numbers and mathematical signs would make the given equation correct? 72 ÷ 8 × 9 − 36 + 20 = 80
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following interchange of numbers and mathematical signs would make the given equation correct?
72 ÷ 8 × 9 − 36 + 20 = 80
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Here, we have to interchange the numbers and mathematical signs that would make the given equation correct.

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 20 and 80, × and +

After interchanging the number and sign we get the:

⇒ 72 ÷ 8 + 9 − 36 × 80 = 20

⇒ 9 + 9 - 36 × 80 = 20

⇒ 9 + 9 - 2880 = 20

⇒ 18 - 2880 = 20

⇒ -2862 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 9 and 36, × and ÷

After interchanging the number and sign we get the:

⇒ 72 × 8 ÷ 36 − 9 + 20 = 80

⇒ 72 × 0.222 - 9 +20 = 80

⇒ 15.84 - 9 + 20 = 80

⇒ 35.84 - 9 = 80

⇒ 26.84 ≠ 80

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 36 and 72, ÷ and −

After interchanging the number and sign we get the:

⇒ 36 - 8 × 9 ÷ 72 + 20 = 80

⇒ 36 - 8 × 0.125 + 20 = 80

⇒ 36 - 1 + 20 = 80

⇒ 56 - 1 = 80

⇒ 55 ≠ 80

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 8 and 9, + and −

⇒ 72 ÷ 9 × 8 + 36 - 20 = 80

⇒ 8 × 8 + 36 - 20 = 80

⇒ 64 + 36 - 20 = 80

⇒ 100 - 20 = 80

⇒ 80 = 80

⇒ LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Husk of a coconut is made of ______ tissue.

questions.solution: The coconut husk is made up of Sclerenchyma tissue. This tissue is characterized by long, tapering cells with thick, lignin-based cell walls. In the case of the coconut husk, this tissue provides protection and support to the developing coconut.
